Name: Searchable Shops
Author: OFTSCQM
Description:
This mod allows you to search for specific items in any shops or catalogs

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use
[/size]
[size=4]- For shops:[/size]
﻿Type in the search bar above the menu, press "Enter" key or the magnifying glass icon to search. 
﻿Press "Escape" key or the 'X' icon to cancel the search. 
[size=3]
[/size][size=4]- For catalogs:[/size]
﻿You can find a page tag with a search icon on the left side. Click it to open the search mod, then everything is the same. 

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.4 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. 
[/list]
